package probe

import "os/exec"

// -overlay reads a file the source names, with the environment of the go
// command, so the exemption covers no such argument.
func toolchainOverlay() error {
	build := exec.Command("go", "build", "-overlay", "overlay.json", "./cmd/x")
	return build.Run()
}

func toolchainOverlayEqual() error {
	list := exec.Command("go", "list", "--overlay=overlay.json")
	_, err := list.Output()
	return err
}
